from collections import Counter

def analyze_column(d_in, d_out, col):
    """Analyze one column: find mapping for each value"""
    rows = len(d_in)
    col_in = [d_in[r][col] for r in range(rows)]
    col_out = [d_out[r][col] for r in range(rows)]
    
    cnt_in = Counter(col_in)
    most_common = cnt_in.most_common()
    dominant = most_common[0][0]
    dominant_count = most_common[0][1]
    
    print(f"Col {col}: most_freq={dominant}, count={dominant_count}, total={rows}")
    print(f"  Distribution: {dict(sorted((cnt_in.items())))}")
    
    # What unique values appear in input/output for this column
    unique_in = set(col_in)
    unique_out = set(col_out)
    print(f"  Input vals: {sorted(unique_in)}, Output vals: {sorted(unique_out)}")
    
    # For each input value, what output values it maps to (and when)
    for v in unique_in:
        positions = [(r, col_in[r], col_out[r]) for r in range(rows) if col_in[r] == v]
        outputs = dict(Counter([o for _, _, o in positions]))
        print(f"  {v} -> {outputs}")
        # Most common mapping for this value
        if outputs:
            most_out = outputs.most_common(1)[0][0]
            print(f"    Most common: {v}->{most_out}")

print("=== Demo 1 Analysis ===")
for c in range(8):
    analyze_column(d1_in, d1_out, c)

print("\n=== Demo 2 Analysis ===")
for c in range(8):
    analyze_column(d2_in, d2_out, c)

from collections import Counter

def analyze_column(d_in, d_out, col):
    """Analyze one column: find mapping for each value"""
    rows = len(d_in)
    col_in = [d_in[r][col] for r in range(rows)]
    col_out = [d_out[r][col] for r in range(rows)]
    
    cnt_in = Counter(col_in)
    most_common = cnt_in.most_common()
    dominant = most_common[0][0]
    dominant_count = most_common[0][1]
    
    print(f"Col {col}: most_freq={dominant}, count={dominant_count}, total={rows}")
    print(f"  Distribution: {dict(sorted(cnt_in.items()))}")
    
    # For each input value, what output values it maps to (and when)
    for v in sorted(cnt_in.keys()):
        # Find positions where this value appears and what it maps to
        outputs = Counter()
        for r in range(rows):
            if col_in[r] == v:
                outputs[col_out[r]] += 1
        if outputs:
            print(f"  {v} -> {dict(outputs)} (most common: {outputs.most_common(1)[0][0]})")
        else:
            print(f"  {v} -> (not found)")

for c in range(8):
    analyze_column(d1_in, d1_out, c)
